realMachineTests.transcript: Stable id + commandSetDigest: fixture cases for declared-id preservation, provisional-id determinism, duplicate-tuple rejection, index-independence, label-rename digest sensitivity, migration warning. Ran validation-tier-planner-smoke.js myself (dist build): all ok, suite ended PASS.

Legacy pin resolver: exact-id/legacy-exact/missing/ambiguous paths, cwd-only and shell-vs-argv distinctness, plus the F-001 non-inventory split (CHK-002:edge:0 covered via waiver plus replacement fixtures, verified above). Ran live, all ok.

Story input collector: rename/delete/story-metadata exclusion, changed_files_unavailable escalation on reader failure, duration-history collection with unknown-duration reporting, verification-intent as reason-context-only (no command-to-seed edge). Ran live, all ok.

Tier planner and fail-closed widening matrix: tier vocabulary and subset invariant, glossed reason-code enumeration, all 4 source kinds, exhaustive no-reduced-tier sweep, empty-universe stop. Ran live, all ok.

validation_plan CLI: --explain vs preview truncation, --json parity, missing-storyId/unknown-tier rejection by name at handler AND core, zero-write byte-identity fixture, no write/persist/execute/run flag accepted, command-policy readOnly/none/all classification, status-line discrimination fixture (F-002 replacement). Ran live myself against the real repo/story and separately in the suite: all ok.

Cross-cutting acceptance guards: RED-before-GREEN commit ordering for every item, zod-bypass rejection for every constrained field, bidirectional test:serial-reference/RESOURCE_POLICY/validate.commands registration, every DoneWhen of CHK-001..CHK-005 covered. I independently ran node packages/main/dist/tasks/validation-tier-planner-smoke.js myself (not trusting the stored receipt): exit 0, 83 ok lines, ended validation-tier-planner-smoke: PASS. Separately confirmed the story's real validate run in test-evidence.json shows allPass:true / PASS across a 120-command inventory (3 apparently-missing checkmark indices [110,117,118] traced to a differing per-command label format, not skipped commands).

closingSelfCheck.summary: All headline promises verified live, not from prose: validation_plan --explain is genuinely actionable, since glossed escalation reasons explain in plain language why fast still selected everything. Both flagged weak spots are legitimate: CHK-002:edge:0 is a real superseded-intent waiver with independently-confirmed replacement fixtures, and CHK-005:happy:0's immutable non-discriminating selector is honestly documented as partially mitigated (fixed by a fixture, not by fixing the actual receipt). The record does not read cleaner than it was: this story surfaced 9 findings across 2 rounds including F-002 (a mechanically-passing false-positive receipt on the story's own flagship claim) and two main-agent self-corrections (F-008 a wrong number copied from a subagent report without verification, F-009 a BRE-vs-ERE transcription slip) that are candidly preserved in findings.json rather than smoothed over.
